name: Our Lady of Mulberry Beach
kicker: Mary and child on Big Mountain
summary: This is the other white statue: Mary holding the child, on the slope of Big Mountain above Mulberry Beach. The catalogue prints her at 32 metres, built in 1992, inaugurated on 31 December 1994, at 60 metres above the sea. She is not Christ the King. That figure is on Small Mountain, with both arms out.
getThere: The Big Mountain slope above Mulberry Beach.
heroCaption: Mary holding the child, head and the child’s arms in frame

notice.title: Do not caption this as Christ
notice.body: Both statues are printed at 32 metres. Christ stands on Small Mountain with both arms out. Mary stands on Big Mountain holding the child.

body: The catalogue places the statue on the slope of Big Mountain, facing the sea, with the church beside it. It prints the statue built in 1992, 32 metres tall, at 60 metres above the sea, and inaugurated on 31 December 1994. The church foundation stone is 19 March 1994. The building is 46 metres by 26 metres, with seats for 1,000.

Mulberry Beach is Bãi Dâu, also Vũng Mây and Bãi Phương Thảo on the provincial page, under this hill. The page records the old names and the rattan that used to grow on Big Mountain. It does not describe a swim service. Come in daylight so the white figure reads against the sky.

A visit length and a fee are not printed. Check on arrival. The Teochew Guanyin temple, Phổ Đà Sơn, is on the same hillside, 500 metres from Mulberry Beach, with an 18 metre figure. That temple has no licensed photograph of the Guanyin here, so it is not a separate page.

figures.caption: The full Mary figure on the hill, with the church and its cross beside the road
figures.alt: Our Lady of Mulberry Beach on Big Mountain, with the church nearby

gettingThere: The statue is on the Big Mountain slope above Mulberry Beach, north of Front Beach and toward the cable-car station on Trần Phú. Minutes from Back Beach are not printed.

legs.heading: From Front Beach
legs.body: North along the shore toward Big Mountain and Trần Phú. Minutes are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the Ho May station
legs.body: The lower station is 1A Trần Phú, on this side of the hill. The walk between the station and the statue is not given a minute count. Check on arrival.

closed: No weekly close is printed. Check on arrival.
admissionNote: No fee is printed on the provincial catalogue page. Check on arrival.
